limitations: Prescribed scripted learning paths with explicit authored starting gold, forces and no enemy AI. Not human balance evidence.
Six deterministic seeds and all current recommended sites (one per build step), with every other engine-legal marked site rejected. Not unconstrained player-site choice.
Actual controller exercised with a stub DOM and no-op canvas; native browser layout/touch/keyboard accessibility testing belongs to a separate review.
Synthetic adversarial fixtures intentionally manipulate isolated engine state or invoke engine methods; these do not claim reachable player inputs.
Engine serialization remains valid at every positive simulation step; training result/evidence is deliberately not persisted or restored.
Parity compares identical actual engine.update subcalls, not one unsplit caller frame: training intentionally observes per fixed tick and stops on a completed objective.
Gold recovery runs ordinary combat. A long artificial shortfall can let the shield lesson enemy be destroyed before support is bought; retry is the honest recovery, not fabricated completion.
No physical device, hardware controller, mobile performance, non-Chromium, packaged desktop or release certification.
